origin.summary: Workout 5 of the 2015 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A descending 27-21-15-9 couplet of rowing calories and thrusters.
